{\LARGE\bfseries\sffamily\color{AtlasNavy} General nonsingular linear systems from right-only products: relative residual\par}\vspace{5pt}
\textbf{Setting ID.} \texttt{MX\_\allowbreak{}S\_\allowbreak{}AXB\_\allowbreak{}RIGHT\_\allowbreak{}RESIDUAL}

Matrix computation

A hidden general nonsingular square matrix is accessible only through right products. Even a perfectly conditioned orthogonal system can require a linear number of queries.

\textbf{Status.} Fully optimal

\textbf{TASK tags.} task family: Matrix computation; formulation: Linear system

\textbf{ORACLE tags.} feedback quality: Exact; operation: Matrix right matvec

\textbf{ALGORITHMS tags.} randomization: Private randomness allowed

\textbf{OUTPUT tags.} object: Vector

\textbf{GUARANTEE tags.} confidence: Fixed numerical success / failure probability

\textbf{RESOURCE tags.} measure: Oracle calls

\needspace{7\baselineskip}\section{1. Setting specification}
\needspace{4\baselineskip}\subsection{Task}
Return a vector \AtlasInlineMath{\widehat x} satisfying the stated relative residual for the general nonsingular system \AtlasInlineMath{Ax=b}.

\needspace{4\baselineskip}\subsection{Admissible model}
\AtlasInlineMath{A\in\mathbb R^{n\times n}} is nonsingular and \AtlasInlineMath{\sigma_{\max}(A)/\sigma_{\min}(A)\le\kappa}. No symmetry, positive definiteness, or absolute spectral scale is assumed.

\AtlasInlineMath{b\in\mathbb R^n} is public and nonzero.

\needspace{4\baselineskip}\subsection{Oracle interface}
The only native access to \AtlasInlineMath{A} is an exact right product \AtlasInlineMath{Av} for any \AtlasInlineMath{v\in\mathbb R^n}. The oracle gives neither transpose products nor direct entry access.

\needspace{4\baselineskip}\subsection{Output}
Return one vector \AtlasInlineMath{\widehat x}, without a separate certificate.

\needspace{4\baselineskip}\subsection{Loss or accuracy criterion}
The success event is \AtlasInlineMath{\|A\widehat x-b\|_2\le\varepsilon\|b\|_2}.

\needspace{4\baselineskip}\subsection{Resource accounting}
Charge each individual right product. Exact arithmetic, including solving a fully recovered system, is free.

\needspace{4\baselineskip}\subsection{Algorithm views and success guarantees}
No Krylov, span, or zero-respecting restriction applies.

For every fixed admissible matrix and nonzero right hand side, require \AtlasInlineMath{\Pr_\omega[\|A\widehat x-b\|_2\le\varepsilon\|b\|_2]\ge 2/3}.

\needspace{7\baselineskip}\section{2. Notation and parameters}
\AtlasInlineMath{n}: Positive integer \textbf{Domain:} Positive integer.

\AtlasInlineMath{\kappa}: Condition-number upper bound at least one \textbf{Domain:} Condition-number upper bound at least one.

\AtlasInlineMath{\varepsilon}: Positive relative residual tolerance \textbf{Domain:} Positive relative residual tolerance.

\AtlasInlineMath{A}: Hidden nonsingular matrix

\AtlasInlineMath{b}: Public nonzero right hand side

\AtlasInlineMath{n_0}: Sufficient dimension constant in Theorem 1.2
